Subject (in full) Change of Director and Deputy Director of the Shanghai Office
of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, 6 Tifeng Road.

Made by....................................................Forwarded by........................................

Mr. C. Chow Director, and Mr. Chao Teh Chang, Deputy
Director of the Shanghai Office of the Waichiaopu, have both
received an order from Nanking to leave their present posts and
join the service of the Waichiaopu at Nanking.
Mr. Yu Ming(余銘), who was Director of the Office
in 1935, has been appointed to take charge and Mr. Chen Ming(陈明)
as Deputy Director.
Mr. Yu Ming is a Cantonese born in Honolulu and is the
nephew of Mr. Sun Fo, President of the Legislative Yuan. He
received his education in the Cornell University of New York and
Soochow Law University of China, holding the degree of LL.B.
Mr. Chen Ming is a native of Fokien and received his
education in Japan. He speaks Japanese most fluently. He was
formerly Chinese Consul in Panama and has been attached to the
Waichiaopu for some time.
The new Directors have not yet taken over charge of
the Shanghai Office which is located at 6 Tifeng Road.
Messrs C.Chow and Chao Teh Chang will probably leave
for Nanking this evening.

事由（全称） 提丰路6号外交部上海办事处处长及副处长之更迭。

呈报人....................................................转呈人........................................

外交部上海办事处处长周先生（C. Chow）及副处长赵德昌先生（Chao Teh Chang）均接获南京命令，离开现职，前往南京外交部任职。
1935年曾任该处处长的余铭（Yu Ming）先生已被任命负责主持工作，陈明（Chen Ming）先生任副处长。
余铭先生为广东人，生于檀香山，是立法院院长孙科先生的侄子。他就读于纽约康奈尔大学及中国东吴法学院，拥有法学学士学位。
陈明先生为福建人，在日本受教育。他能讲流利的日语。他曾任驻巴拿马中国领事，并在外交部任职一段时间。
新任职的处长尚未接管位于提丰路6号的上海办事处。
周先生（C.Chow）和赵德昌先生可能将于今晚启程前往南京。

July 7, 1937.    3    Morning Translation.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

MEETING OF PRIVATE SCHOOLS FEDERATION AND PRIMARY
SCHOOL TEACHERS' FEDERATION

At 3 p.m. yesterday, the Private Schools
Federation and the Primary School Teachers' Federation
held a joint meeting at the Min Sung Middle School (民立中学),
Sinkiang Road, Chapai. Some 200 persons representing various
local schools were present.
Mr. Feng Ih-sien (馮一先) reported that a
satisfactory result had been reached in the negotiations
opened by the deputies of the Private Schools Federation
with the Shanghai Municipal Council over the question of
the issue of the grant-in-aid.
The following resolutions were passed :-
1) That energetic efforts be made to bring about the issue
of the full grant-in-aid by the Shanghai City Government.
2) The organisation of the Private Schools Federation
be strengthened in order to afford proper protection
to private schools.
Resolved that the International Settlement Private
Schools Federation be reorganized and known as the
Shanghai Private Schools Federation; that persons be
appointed to undertake the reorganization.
3) That the principals of primary schools throughout
Shanghai submit an appeal to the Bureau of Social Affairs
on July 12; that they gather before 8 a.m. that day at
the Wu Pei Middle School (沪北中學), Jukong Road, in
order to leave together for the Bureau.
The meeting terminated at 6 p.m.

Social Evening News dated July 6:

NEW CHIEF OF SHANGHAI OFFICE OF FOREIGN MINISTRY
TO ASSUME OFFICE NEXT WEEK

Accompanied by Mr. Chen Chia, Vice Minister
of Foreign Affairs, Mr. Yu Min (余伋), newly appointed
Chief of the Shanghai Office of the Ministry of Foreign
Affairs, came to Shanghai from Nanking the other day and
made necessary arrangements with Mr. Chow Yu (周), his
predecessor. Together with the Vice Minister, Mr. Yu Min
returned to the Capital yesterday evening.
According to information received, Mr. Yu
Min and Mr. Chen Min (陳敏), newly appointed Deputy
Chief of the Office, will come to Shanghai to assume office
next week.

Ta Kung Pao (telegram from Soochow):

THE KAYAU MURDER CASE

In connection with the appeal in the Kayau
murder case, Presiding Judge Wu Yu-han (吳玉涵) of the
Kiangsu High Court at 11 a.m. July 6 attended the Court
and ordered in the presence of the accused Mao Yung-fu

1937年7月7日。    3    晨间译件。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：-

私立学校联合会与小学教师联合会会议

昨日下午3时，私立学校联合会与小学教师联合会在闸北新疆路民立中学举行联席会议。代表本地各学校的约200人出席。
冯一先（Feng Ih-sien）先生报告称，私立学校联合会代表就发放补助金一事与上海公共租界工部局进行的谈判已取得满意结果。
通过以下决议：-
1) 积极努力促使上海市政府发放全额补助金。
2) 加强私立学校联合会的组织，以为私立学校提供适当保护。
决议重组国际租界私立学校联合会，更名为上海私立学校联合会；并任命人员负责重组工作。
3) 上海各地小学校长于7月12日向市社会局提交请愿书；当日上午8时前在菊恭路沪北中学集合，以便一同前往社会局。
会议于下午6时结束。

7月6日《社会晚报》：

外交部上海办事处新主任将于下周就职

新任外交部上海办事处主任余伋（Yu Min）先生日前由南京抵沪，随同前来的是外交部次长陈家（Chen Chia）先生，并与前任周 Yu（Chow Yu）先生作了必要的交接安排。余伋先生随同次长于昨晚返回首都。
据收到的消息，余伋先生和新任办事处副主任陈敏（Chen Min）先生将于下周来沪就职。

《大公报》（苏州电）：

贾尧谋杀案

就贾尧（Kayau）谋杀案的上诉事宜，江苏高等法院主审法官吴玉涵（Wu Yu-han）于7月6日上午11时出庭，并在被告毛永福面前下令

July 3, 1937. Morning Translation.

Lih Pao and other local newspapers :-

CLASH BETWEEN WORKERS OF CHINA SOAP COMPANY AND THE POLICE

On the morning of July 2, the workers of the
China Soap Company (中國肥皂公司), a British firm, No. 2310
Yangtsepoo Road, declared a "tai-kung" strike to push
their demand for better treatment. They remained in the
factory.
At 3 p.m. a large number of Chinese and
foreign detectives and policemen arrived in vans and
desired to enter the factory to drive out the workers.
A clash ensued, during which the workers threw stones at
the Police. This lasted until 4.30 p.m. when three
foreign policemen were seriously injured, and three Chinese
policemen less seriously. Twenty workers were arrested
and will be arraigned before the Court this morning.
The workers left the factory last night.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

PROCEEDINGS AGAINST COTTON YARN MANIPULATORS TO BE HELD
IN SHANGHAI

As investigations conducted by Mr. Wu Ting-chong,
Minister of Industry, and other officials recently show
that Mr. Wu Chi-ting (吳稚暉), Director of the Internal
Revenue Administration, and Mr. Sheng Sheng-yi (盛昇頤),
Director of the Consolidated Tax Office for Kiangsu, Chekiang
and Anhwei, are found to have connection with the late
manipulations on the cotton yarn market in Shanghai, the
Procuratorate of the Shanghai First Special District Court
has appointed Procurator Sung Kan-san (宋根山) to hold
a court of investigation into the case at 9 a.m. July 3.
Summonses against accused Wu Chi-ting and
Sheng Sheng-yi, witness Mo Han-chu (穆漢初), Chairman of
the Board of Directors of the Cotton Exchange, and two
brokers for interrogation have been sent out, but it still
remains to be seen whether the court of investigation will
be open to the public.

Shun Pao (Nanking telegram) :-

Summonses against Wu Chi-ting and Sheng Sheng-
yi were served at about 5 p.m. July 2, and the Ministry
of Finance appointed members of the Revenue Police Squad
to escort the two accused to Shanghai in the evening.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers (Nanking telegram) :-

CHANGES IN FOREIGN OFFICE ADMINISTRATION

On July 2, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
announced that Mr. Yu Ming (余銘) was appointed Chief of
the Shanghai Office of the Foreign Ministry, with Mr. Chen
Min (陳敏) as Deputy Chief, while Mr. Chow Yu (周),
then Chief of the Shanghai Office was transferred to the
post of Secretary to the Ministry and Mr. Chao Tihchwang
(趙鐵莊), the then Deputy Chief, to the post of Chief of
the General Affairs Department

1937年7月3日。晨间译件。

《立报》及其他本地报纸：-

中国肥皂公司工人与警察发生冲突

7月2日上午，位于杨树浦路2310号的英商中国肥皂公司（China Soap Company）工人宣布“怠工”罢工，以推动改善待遇的要求。他们留在工厂内。
下午3时，大批中西探员和警察乘货车抵达，试图进入工厂驱赶工人。随后发生冲突，期间工人向警察投掷石块。冲突持续至下午4时30分，三名外籍巡捕受重伤，三名华捕受轻伤。二十名工人被捕，将于今晨被提堂审讯。
工人们已于昨晚离开工厂。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：-

操纵棉纱市场案将在上海审理

鉴于实业部部长吴鼎冲（Wu Ting-chong）及其他官员最近开展的调查显示，国税局局长吴稚暉（Wu Chi-ting）先生和苏浙皖统税局局长盛昇頤（Sheng Sheng-yi）先生被发现与近期上海棉纱市场操纵案有关，上海第一特区地方法院检察处已指派检察官宋根山（Sung Kan-san）于7月3日上午9时对此案进行侦查庭讯。
针对被告吴稚暉和盛昇頤，证人棉花交易所董事长穆汉初（Mo Han-chu）以及两名经纪人的传票已发出，以待传讯，但侦查庭是否公开审理尚待观察。

《申报》（南京电）：-

对吴稚暉和盛昇頤的传票于7月2日下午5时许送达，财政部指派缉私队成员于当晚护送两名被告前往上海。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸（南京电）：-

外交部行政人事变动

7月2日，外交部宣布任命余铭（Yu Ming）为外交部上海办事处主任，陈敏（Chen Min）为副主任，而时任上海办事处主任的周 Yu（Chow Yu）调任部秘书，时任副主任的赵铁庄（Chao Tihchwang）调任总务司司长

REPORT
Date. March 25. 1938.

Subject The staff of the Shanghai Office of the Wai Chiao Pu and
their biographies.

Made by and Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao Liang

1. Mr. Yu Ming (余銘), Director. Born in Honolulu of
Cantonese parents. Educated in Cornell University,
New York, U.S.A. and Soochow Law University, China.
Holds degree of L.L.B. Cousin of Mr. Sun Fo. He
served as secretary to the latter at Canton some years
ago and was later transferred to the Wai Chiao Pu
where he was appointed Councillor. For the past
3 years, he has held the present position of Director
of the Shanghai Office of the Wai Chiao Pu.

2. T.C. Chao (趙鐵章) Chao Teh Chang. Chief Secretary
and Departmental Chief. Native of Shanghai.
Son of Chao Chun Ching (趙晉卿), ex-Vice Minister
of Industry. Educated in Kwang Hwa (光華)
University ( ), Shanghai, and Michigan University,
U.S.A.. He was sent by the Ministry of Industry to
Europe to study commerce at Government expense.
On his return he was appointed secretary to the
Diplomatic Discussion Committee.

3. Mr. Robert C. Lee (李榮耀) Lee Yung Yau, Secretary.
Native of Canton. Son of Mr. Frank Lee, Chinese
Minister to Poland, once acting Minister of the
Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Received his
education in Chicago University and the Soochow Law
University. He has held the position of Secretary
to the Shanghai Office for the past 3½ years.

4. Mr. Chang Moong Ling (張夢齡), Secretary. Native of
Chapoo, graduate of Kwang Hwa University. Has served
as Secretary with above office for five years.

5. Mr. Y.K. Yee (余榮基), Assistant Secretary. Native

日期：1938年3月25日。

主题：外交部上海办事处职员及其简历。

制作及呈报人：谭绍良警司

1. 余銘先生，主任。出生于檀香山，父母为广东人。曾就读于美国纽约康奈尔大学及中国东吴法学院。拥有法学学士学位。系孙佛（音译）先生之堂弟。数年前曾在广州担任后者之秘书，后调至外交部，被任命为参事。过去3年间，一直担任现任之外交部上海办事处主任职务。

2. 赵铁章（Chao Teh Chang），首席秘书兼科室主管。上海本地人。系前实业部次长赵晋卿之子。曾就读于上海光华大学及美国密歇根大学。由实业部委派，公费赴欧洲研习商业。回国后被任命为外交讨论委员会秘书。

3. 李荣耀（Lee Yung Yau）先生，秘书。广东人。系中国驻波兰公使、曾任外交部代理部长李弗兰克（Frank Lee，音译）先生之子。曾就读于芝加哥大学及东吴法学院。在过去三年半中，一直担任上海办事处秘书一职。

4. 张梦龄先生，秘书。乍浦人，光华大学毕业。在上述办事处担任秘书已五年。

5. 余荣基先生，助理秘书。籍贯

REPORT
Subject (in full) Mr. Tang Liu 唐榴 alias Tang Nyeu Tsu 唐念慈
Made by Supt Tan Shao Liang Forwarded by Henry Robertson C.D.I.
Mr. Tang Liu 唐榴 who took over office yesterday as Acting
Director of the Shanghai Office of the Ministry of Foreign
Affairs is a native of Canton of about 30 years of age.
He is the son of Mr. Tang Shao Yi (a well known diplomat who
was formerly Premier of the Peking Government). The new
Director has been appointed in consequence of the continued
illness of S.K.Chen and of the transfer of Mr. Liu Yuen Fang
Assistant Director to the Ministry at Nanking.
Mr. Tang was formerly a 3rd Class Secretary in the Wai Chiao Pu
and in the Ministry of Justice. He also served as secretary to
the Chinese Legation in London and recently served as Chinese
Consul at Nagasaki and Singapore.
So far it can be ascertained, Mr. Tang is educated and
respectable.
Tan Shaoliang
Superintendent.
D.C. (Or & Sp. Br's)

报告
主题（全称）唐榴 别名 唐念慈
制作人 谭绍良警司 呈报人 Henry Robertson 首席侦探督察。
唐榴先生于昨日接任外交部上海办事处代理主任，系广东人，年龄约30岁。
他是唐绍仪先生（著名外交家，曾任北京政府总理）之子。新任主任的任命是由于陈SK（音译）持续患病，以及副主任刘元芳（音译）先生调往南京本部所致。
唐先生此前曾任外交部及司法部三等秘书。他还曾担任中国驻伦敦公使馆秘书，近期曾任中国驻长崎及新加坡领事。
据目前所知，唐先生受过良好教育且品行端正。
谭绍良
警司。
